scope: six anonymous groups, three paired fixed cases each; no model/stage identity, audio, video, NLL, or weak-reference text supplied
unit: one caption; group means over the same three cases are diagnostic only

score_scale.1: No usable choreography on this axis, e.g. only music description or absent actions
score_scale.2: Sparse/static/generic actions, weak organization or detail
score_scale.3: Some concrete dynamic sequence; usable parts but generic, repetitive or underspecified
score_scale.4: Clear, coherent and reasonably varied action plan with concrete transitions or details
score_scale.5: Consistently strong action organization, varied executable movement and convincing transitions; text evidence only

requirements: Read all 18 captions, do not extrapolate from a subset
Score text content separately from computed fixed-window format compliance
Missing transition is not automatically physically impossible
More words or more action categories do not automatically score better
Do not punish creative alternatives merely because they differ from one observed dance
Record rationale per case and group, near duplicates and uncertainty; allow unknown or ties
Model/phase identities are decoded only after the review JSON is saved
source_scope_limit: three cases cannot establish population-level training benefit or statistical model superiority
